Meeting Date:                 4/27/2022
Sponsor(s):                   Scott, Jr. (24)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 4-J at 1604 S Sawyer Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                       ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the RT-4,
Residential Two-Flat Townhouse and Multi-Unit Districts symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 4-J in the area bound by:

      a line 50 feet south of and parallel to West 16'" Street; South Sawyer Avenue; a line 75
      feet south of and parallel to West 16'" Street and the alley next east of and parallel to
      South Sawyer Avenue,

to those of a B2-1, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                           Iphael Scott Jr.
                                                          ATiplerman, 24*" Ward




Common Address:
1604 S. Sawyer Avenue
